values.content:
=You are a local SEO analyst. Analyse this grid rank data and provide actionable insights.

Business: {{ $('load-config').item.json.business_name }}
Industry: {{ $('load-config').item.json.industry }}
Target Keywords: {{ $('load-config').item.json.target_keywords }}

Grid rank data (suburb → keyword → rank):
{{ JSON.stringify($json, null, 2) }}

Provide:

1. overall_score: % of suburb/keyword combos where rank is 1-3 (green zone)
2. green_zones: suburbs where rank is 1-3 for most keywords
3. yellow_zones: suburbs where rank is 4-7
4. red_zones: suburbs where rank is 8+ or not ranking
5. biggest_wins: Top 5 keyword/suburb combos with best ranks (celebrate these)
6. biggest_opportunities: Top 5 keyword/suburb combos with worst ranks but highest potential

For each red zone, prescribe EXACTLY what to fix:
7. red_zone_fixes: [{
     suburb: "...",
     keyword: "...",
     current_rank: ...,
     fix_actions: [
       "Publish GBP post mentioning [suburb] and [keyword]",
       "Request 3 reviews specifically mentioning [suburb]",
       "Add [suburb] to service area description",
       etc.
     ],
     auto_fixable: true/false,
     estimated_rank_improvement: "X positions in Y weeks"
   }]

8. weekly_summary: 150-word plain English summary for the owner WhatsApp message

Return as JSON.

nodes.name: Claude — Grid Gap Analysis & Fix Plan
nodes.notes: Claude analyses the heat map, identifies red zones, and prescribes specific fixes for each underperforming suburb

nodes.name: Split Red Zone Fixes
nodes.notes: Processes each red zone fix independently

values.content:
=Write a GBP post to improve ranking for '{{ $json.keyword }}' in {{ $json.suburb }}.

Business: {{ $('load-config').item.json.business_name }}
Industry: {{ $('load-config').item.json.industry }}
Current rank: #{{ $json.current_rank }} — target: top 3

The post MUST:
- Mention '{{ $json.suburb }}' naturally at least 3 times
- Include '{{ $json.keyword }}' or a close variant at least twice
- Reference a local landmark, street, or known characteristic of {{ $json.suburb }}
- Include a strong local call to action
- Be 250-300 words
- Sound human and genuine, not keyword-stuffed
- End with a question to encourage engagement

Also write an SMS review request to send to recent customers in {{ $json.suburb }}:
- 160 chars max
- Ask them to mention {{ $json.suburb }} in their review
- Include the direct Google review link placeholder: [REVIEW_LINK]

Return JSON: { "gbp_post": "...", "review_sms": "..." }

meta.description: Runs a city-wide GBP rank scan every Wednesday using BrightLocal API. Maps rank at every suburb coordinate as a heat map. Claude identifies red zones and auto-generates targeted GBP posts + review request SMSs to push those suburbs to #1. Reports overall city coverage score to owner.
